_note: Invented pairs for `fact_fold`. `drop` is a fact a write would add (or an existing bullet), `keep` the bullet that may hold it. `fold`: whether a person would let the drop go. `guard`: what the code check (`fact_fold.covers`) decides on its own; `blind` marks a pair only the model can tell apart (no number, date, name or negation word differs). `names` / `own` are the page's other names and the allowed words.

pairs.keep: Artist X is [[Alice Example]]'s favourite artist
pairs.drop: [[Alice Example]]'s favourite artist is Artist X.

pairs.keep: Likes jazz and plays the saxophone on weekends.
pairs.drop: Le gusta el jazz y toca el saxofón los fines de semana.
Birthday is on the 19th of March

pairs.keep: Pays 40 euros a month for the gym
pairs.drop: Pays 45 euros a month for the gym

pairs.keep: Works with [[Bob Example]] on the report
pairs.drop: Works with [[Carol Example]] on the report
Favourite restaurant is Casa Example in Lisbon
Planned to visit Lisbon next spring
